correctness.rationale: Gaussian conditioning reduces risk to 1/12 - C(t)/(eta+t^3/3) with exact C(t). Exact symbolic calculation verifies C, C prime, E stationary noise function, its derivative factorization, E(1)=8/273 and E prime(1)=264/1183. On (0,1], H<0 and C prime>0; U is increasing with one root t0 in (2/3,1); J<0 and G>0 on [t0,1] prove E strictly increasing. The sign of F prime changes exactly once for eta<8/273 and never changes otherwise. Thus uniqueness and full all-positive-eta classification follow without relying on finite samples. Code and proof scope match.

value.rationale: The natural one-measurement integrated Gaussian-path recovery design is completely classified for all known positive observation-noise variances. The exact finite noise threshold at which the optimal site activates the terminal boundary, strict optimizer uniqueness, and linear activation law provide a nontrivial benchmark for smoothing/sensor scheduling. These are neither table recomputation nor an arbitrary tiny adjustment: the endpoint-support phase is a qualitative global optimization feature absent from generic design formulas.
